why_this_file: the coordinator's correction: a measured cost basis must use the peak of the process TREE or its cgroup, not the main process RSS. Every footprint figure this round used or published is listed here with the thing that actually measured it, and the figures that came from main-process RSS alone are labelled as such

figures.figure: 8 458 399 744 B (7.88 GiB) for long_window_own_depth; 10 279 276 544 B (9.57 GiB) for long_window_local_support_67
figures.scope_of_the_measurement: the single python process that ran the cell. It excludes the parent driver process in the same cgroup, excludes any child, and excludes the cgroup's page cache and kernel memory
figures.where_it_was_used: the sealed design's `informed_by` field, this round's gate thresholds (--peak-bytes), and the Q2_CONTEXT_BOUNDED design's restriction argument
figures.label_required: MAIN_PROCESS_RSS_ONLY — NOT a tree or cgroup peak
figures.provenance: retained cost pilots of Q2_CONTEXT v1, run on this same coordinator host on 2026-09-21

figures.figure: 7.4G cgroup peak for the same arm's pilot, 2026-09-26
figures.measured_by: systemd's accounting for the transient scope (`Consumed ... 7.4G memory peak`), i.e. memory.peak for the cgroup containing the driver process AND the cell child AND the cgroup's page cache
figures.scope_of_the_measurement: the process TREE plus cgroup-charged page and kernel memory: this is the figure a placement decision must use
figures.note: this is the measurement against which the requested 9 GiB MemoryMax and 8.1 GiB MemoryHigh must be judged, and it is what shows the job was throttled (Pgscan 61 467 701) without ever reaching its MemoryMax

figures.figure: 7.05 GiB reported by this session's scratchpad memory probe for long_window_own_depth (10 updates + two full validation predicts)
figures.label_required: MAIN_PROCESS_RSS_ONLY — NOT a tree or cgroup peak
figures.cgroup_peak_of_the_same_probe: 6.7G, from systemd's accounting for its scope
figures.unresolved_and_reported_as_such: the main-process RSS high-water mark (7.05 GiB) is LARGER than the cgroup peak systemd recorded for the same scope (6.7G). The two are sampled differently - ru_maxrss is a kernel high-water mark for one process, memory.peak is the cgroup's peak charged usage - and this round does not resolve the discrepancy. It is reported, not explained away, and neither figure is used as a tree peak

figures.figure: 0.87-1.06 GiB for the four W60 arms (pilots and fits, this block and the bounded block)
figures.cgroup_peaks_of_the_same_cells: 519.6M-556.7M per scope, from systemd's accounting; for these arms the cgroup peak is BELOW the main-process RSS figure as well

consequence_for_this_round: every peak-RSS number in the published tables, and every --peak-bytes threshold the memory gate used, is MAIN_PROCESS_RSS_ONLY and is labelled so wherever it appears. The design's `informed_by` field, sealed before any fit, carries the same main-process figures; that text is not rewritten after the fact, and this file is the correction of record beside it
consequence_for_the_next_round: a cost pilot that is to justify a placement must record the cgroup peak of its own scope, not resource.getrusage of one process. tools/df_e1_block.run_cell records only the latter, which is a defect of the cost basis and is reported here, not repaired mid-round
